about: The developer fighters: never offered in the app (not in PORTED, no place in the score order), in the same format as roster.json and appended to it by bf_content::registry::roster() so a fight file can name them. TARGET DUMMY has no weapon and no abilities (kind "dummy", bf_core::roster::DUMMY): it drifts round the ring, never attacks and can still be knocked out. Its unlocks never come (it deals no damage, so it never levels up); every_bars is there because the engine reads it of any unlock.
